text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ahem! Well, once I actually ran it, it was 
nothing at all. As expected of Turbo!

Having somehow completed her Make Debut 
safely, Twin Turbo returned in high 
spirits.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, who was that bawling their 
eyes out just a moment ago, I wonder...?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"That was... I just got a little worried, 
that's all! And I wasn't crying, either!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. With a run like that, there's 
nothing to worry about anymore, right?
Just as I was about to reply...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —A graded race.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ikuno, what's a "graded-stakes"?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"If you truly intend to rise to the top of 
the Twinkle Series, you will eventually 
have to run in graded stakes races. And—"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
The turnout was nothing compared to today. 
30,000, 50,000... no—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to GⅠ races, over 100,000 
spectators pack into the stands.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Gaaaaah, seriously!? A hundred thousand 
people is, like...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Uuuu, Traineeer, reduce it, reduce it, 
pleeease reduce it~.

Telling me to reduce the imaginary 
audience is a tall order. However...

After her "gate phobia," something had to 
be done about this extreme "timidity"...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"...It seems we are thinking the same 
thing, Trainer. And this cowardice is..."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It looks like it could affect not just the 
main event, but also group training 
sessions and mock races.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I really want her to get used to the "pack 
of Umamusume" somehow, though.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo doesn't want a huge crowd, but if 
it's just Nature and Ikuno, Turbo's fine 
with it...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Just the two of us can hardly be called 
lively. You belong among far, far more 
Umamusume—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"I have to learn to run with strong 
determination. If I can't do that, 
then..."

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: If I can't, then what?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I really don't want to say something like 
this, but...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"If she cannot get used to it, she might 
not even be able to stay in the JRA."

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Huh, what's "Chuo"...?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
If your record is so poor that you 
languish at the bottom, you might even be 
forced to transfer to the local 
circuits...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"If that happens, I will have to say 
goodbye to my current friends. And 
probably to you too, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeh, Turbo doesn't want that, no no 
noooo~!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, Turbo wants to get used to it! I 
gotta get used to it somehow!

"Even so, throwing her into a crowd of 
unfamiliar Umamusume right off the bat is 
bound to end in disaster."

There was no choice but to get her used to 
lively environments step by step.

Returning to the waiting room for the time 
being—
(Knock-knock, *click!*)

text_block_list.name: Helios & Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ayyyyy, good job Turbo-☆★彡 Annnnd... 
vroooom-vroooom!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, huh, Ikuno? It really is Ikuno. 
What are you doing here?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Ms. Helios... and Ms. Palmer? Why are the 
two of you here...?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"I'm Daitaku Helios☆ A super high-hype, 
super front-running sprint Umamusume, ya 
get me? And over here is—!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I'm Mejiro Palmer. Just like Helios, I'm a 
Classic-tier runaway speedster Umamusume 
right now!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Since I just finished cheering on Turbo, I 
figured I'd drop by the after-party!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! Come to think of it, I might've 
heard Palmer's voice earlier! Telling me 
to calm down~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, glad you heard me then. You looked 
pretty nervous, after all.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Turbo☆ That run just now was so good, so 
fire, totally hype★ Aren't the vibes 
unreal?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: R-Really...?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Well, of cooourse! Turbo's vibes are 
always smolderin' hot!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I'm way better than that! I'm 
waaaay, waaay more amazing!”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, talk that talk! Woo-hoo♪ Love that 
confident energy... right!

She fit in... surprisingly well. Though 
the two are quite noisy, Twin Turbo isn't 
scared of them in the slightest.

Her hype and energy are pretty close to 
Daitaku Helios's. And Mejiro Palmer looks 
ready to offer her bright, warm support as 
well.

—An invaluable talent. If that is the 
case—

I spoke with Daitaku Helios and Mejiro 
Palmer, telling them that I'd love for 
them to become Twin Turbo's companions.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ah, join Turbo's crew starting now? Isn't 
that, like, impossible? I mean...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"We've been besties since the day we were 
born! ★ Ayy, Turbo! Here's to teaming up 
even more from now on!!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, you're right. Whenever you need 
help, past, present, or future, I'll 
always be there for you.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Really!? Then from now on, every single 
one of you is a member of Team Turbo!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, as long as it's this noisy, it'll 
be fine, right?
choice_data_list:
Yeah, let's make it work with five 
Umamusume!

Yeah, let's do this with all five 
Umamusume!

text_block_list.text:
"Timidity is an expression of deep-seated 
anxiety in one's heart. If that is so—"

We just have to wash away those anxieties 
together, surrounded by a circle of 
bright, cheerful Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
All right! Turbo's gonna take everyone on! 
So, Trainer, what race are we entering 
next?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Trainer, let's take our time here...

I nod slowly. My opinion was entirely the 
same as Ikuno Dictus's.
choice_data_list:
Let's not set a specific goal—let's just 
enter lots of races!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
That's a lot! Got it! Turbo's gonna burn 
out with everything she's got in every 
single race! Yeah!

Instead of aiming for the big leagues 
right away, I'll let her get used to races 
and other Umamusume. I decided to focus on 
resolving these issues for a while.
